key.name: server-url
key.summary: Address of the last server that connected successfully

key.name: welcome-shown
key.summary: Whether the welcome carousel was already completed

key.name: album-sort
key.summary: How the album grid is sorted: name, artist, year-desc, year-asc or added

key.name: last-album-id
key.summary: Album of the song that played last

key.name: last-position
key.summary: Where in that song playback stopped, in seconds

key.name: endless-radio
key.summary: When the queue ends, keep playing songs similar to the last one

key.name: background-playback
key.summary: Keep playing after the window is closed

key.name: report-listens
key.summary: Tell the server what is playing and count finished listens

key.name: color-scheme
key.summary: Style: 0 follows the system, 1 is always light, 2 is always dark

key.name: cover-colors
key.summary: Tint the album page and the player cards with the cover colour

key.name: replay-gain
key.summary: Volume normalization from ReplayGain tags: 0 off, 1 per track, 2 per album

key.name: repeat
key.summary: Repeat: none, the whole queue, or the current track
